sources.note: Current legal terms expressly identify Tonaquint Data Centers, LLC as doing business as ValorC3 Data Centers, directly proving one continuing legal entity.

Official January 20, 2025 release says the company formerly operating as Tonaquint is now ValorC3, identifies all three operating markets and continues to describe the business as a CVC DIF portfolio company.

Official manager release states that DIF signed to acquire Tonaquint through DIF Core-Plus Infrastructure Fund III and that management continued to hold a minority stake; it does not state the exact legal closing day or percentages.
Official manager release identifies Tonaquint as a DIF investee acquired in December 2022 and describes EdgeX as the Oklahoma City facility added beneath the platform.

Direct command-line retrieval was blocked with HTTP 403, but an independent in-app browser navigation redirected the old domain to the live ValorC3 homepage. The model's redirect conclusion is accepted with this source-health correction.
Current leadership page supports the named senior executive roster used to test continuity across the rebrand.
Current company page states 19 MW of existing capacity across Utah, Idaho and Oklahoma, a 10 MW Boise campus under development and a second 10 MW facility planned.

April 30, 2026 company release confirms the Apterra development-credit facility and still calls CVC DIF the platform's sponsor, supporting current ownership and distinguishing debt from an equity transfer.
